title: District Plan and Map
previewText:
The regulations of this Chapter are designed to implement the Special Atlantic Avenue Mixed Use District Plan. The district plan includes the following map in the Appendix to this Chapter:

Map 1 Designated Streetscape Frontages

Such map is hereby incorporated and made part of this Resolution for the purpose of specifying locations where the special regulations and requirements set forth in the text of this Chapter
